title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse
seo_title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse in Springfield, MO
description: Story time at Graddy's Playhouse features books about home read with Adam Graddy's real estate team, plus a look at the new exhibit. The house has hands-on STEM activities and pretend play spaces, including a kitchen, living room, and backyard, and it is aimed at kids. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026 at 10:30 AM at 438 E St. Louis St. in Springfield, MO, and repeats on the first Friday of each month.
